newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets ticking over.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets ticking over.

text.p: Europe's raw cotton markets were kept ticking over by a general demand for nearby delivery in small volumes, industry sources said on Tuesday.
Italy saw fresh trades in top grade Central Asian cottons on the back of an increasing flow-through from this origin into the major European ports, they said.
But interest from import buyers in Turkey appeared to be tailing off, they added.

Several sources said the spinning sector had not covered all of its requirements for April/May or even February/March delivery but the strong U.S. dollar was persuading buyers to hold off for the moment. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
